title: Usage
description: Per-attempt token/cost usage as reported by a harness (contract.py Usage, §4). Every token-shaped field is either a non-negative integer or the literal string 'UNKNOWN' -- null is never allowed, so a careless consumer cannot coerce 'no value' to 0.

model_id.description: The realized model id the harness reports for this attempt.

reported_by.description: The harness/tool that produced this Usage record, e.g. 'claude-cli/2.1.263'.

cost_usd.description: USD. null means 'not computed' -- a renderer must print 'not computed', never $0.00.
